name: Cyno
title: Judicator of Secrets
description: The General Mahamatra of the Akademiya, leader of all the Matras. He has a unique sense of humor that never fails to leave a deep impression.

skillTalents.name: Invoker's Spear
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer
skillTalents.description:
Performs a swift thrust, dealing Electro DMG to opponents along the path.

When Cyno is under the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, he will instead unleash a Mortuary Rite that deals thunderous AoE Electro DMG and extends the duration of Pactsworn Pathclearer.

"This judgment brooks no choice. There is no rejection or acceptance here... We have both long been bound up in this conviction."

skillTalents.name: Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness
skillTalents.description:
Calls upon a divine spirit to indwell him, morphing into the Pactsworn Pathclearer.

Pactsworn Pathclearer
Cyno's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Electro DMG that cannot be overridden.
·Cyno's Elemental Mastery and resistance to interruption will increase, and he gains immunity to Electro-Charged DMG.

This effect will be canceled when Cyno leaves the field and lasts a maximum of 18s.

The secret rituals passed down within the ancient nation are as a final judgment to the General Mahamatra.
Whether now or in the past, whether great storm or serpent, none shall shake the majesty of the law.

modifiers.label: While Pactsworn Pathclearer is active — Cyno Elemental Mastery (including state entry from A Star With Which to Start the Journey)

passiveTalents.name: Featherfall Judgment
passiveTalents.description:
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state activated by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, Cyno will enter the Endseer stance at intervals. If he activates Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer while affected by this stance, he will activate the Judication effect, increasing the DMG of this Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer by 35%, and firing off 3 Duststalker Bolts that deal 100% of Cyno's ATK as Electro DMG.
Duststalker Bolt DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

Enhanced kit — conditional Radiance state
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state, he will enter the Endseer stance at intervals. If he activates Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer while affected by this stance, he will activate the Judication effect, increasing the DMG of this Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer by 35%, and firing off 3 Duststalker Bolts that deal 100% of Cyno's ATK as Electro DMG. Duststalker Bolt DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: When Judication is triggered, Cyno will instead fire 3 Duststalker Bolts - Starsame to his front, dealing Electro DMG at 200% of his ATK. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG.

modifiers.label: Judication — only this Mortuary Rite Skill cast; excludes all ordinary and Starsame Duststalker Bolts

skills.label: Judication — one ordinary Duststalker Bolt, outside Radiance: Stellar-Conduct (three bolts per proc; replaces no other variant)
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct — one Duststalker Bolt - Starsame, replacing the ordinary Bolt (three bolts per Judication proc)

passiveTalents.name: Authority Over the Nine Bows
passiveTalents.description:
Cyno's DMG values will be increased based on his Elemental Mastery as follows:
· Pactsworn Pathclearer's Normal Attack DMG is increased by 150% of his Elemental Mastery.
· Duststalker Bolt DMG from his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is increased by 250% of his Elemental Mastery.

Enhanced kit — conditional Radiance state
Cyno's DMG values will be increased based on his Elemental Mastery as follows:
· Pactsworn Pathclearer's Normal Attack DMG is increased by 150% of his Elemental Mastery.
· Duststalker Bolt DMG from his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is increased by 250% of his Elemental Mastery.
· Duststalker Bolts - Starsame from the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment": 600% of Elemental Mastery.

modifiers.label: Pactsworn Pathclearer Normal Attacks only — attached damage based on Cyno EM
Ordinary Duststalker Bolts only, including C6 — attached damage based on Cyno EM; excludes Starsame
Radiance Starsame Bolts only, including C6 replacement — raw attached damage based on Cyno EM, not a dimensionless reaction bonus

passiveTalents.name: The Gift of Silence
passiveTalents.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Sumeru Expedition for 20 hours.

passiveTalents.name: A Star With Which to Start the Journey
passiveTalents.description:
If Cyno unleashes the Elemental Skill Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer while not in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state, he will enter Pactsworn Pathclearer for 6s.
Additionally, when in a Polestar Field, Cyno will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.

constellations.name: Ordinance: Unceasing Vigil
constellations.description:
After using Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, Cyno's Normal Attack SPD will be increased by 20% for 10s. If the Judication effect of his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is triggered during Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer, the duration of this increase will be refreshed.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

Enhanced kit — conditional Radiance state
After using Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, Cyno's Normal Attack SPD will be increased by 20% for 10s. If the Judication effect of his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is triggered during Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer, the duration of this increase will be refreshed.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: When Cyno enters the Pactsworn Pathclearer state, he will also gain the Together We Rise effect: Elemental Mastery is increased by 200. During this time, when switching characters from Cyno on the field, the incoming active character will take on the Together We Rise effect for the remaining duration.

modifiers.label: After Wolf's Swiftness — Normal Attack SPD; Judication refreshes duration
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct — Together We Rise current holder only; Cyno on entry, transferable to the incoming active character for the remaining duration

constellations.name: Ceremony: Homecoming of Spirits
constellations.description:
When Cyno's Normal Attacks hit opponents, his Electro DMG Bonus will increase by 10% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 5 stacks.

Enhanced kit — conditional Radiance state
When Cyno's Normal Attacks hit opponents, his Electro DMG Bonus will increase by 10% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 5 stacks.

Additionally, when characters affected by Together We Rise hit opponents with their Normal Attacks or Charged Attacks, their Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt is increased by 16%. This effect, which can trigger once every 0.1s, will remain active for the remaining duration of Together We Rise. Max 5 stacks.

modifiers.label: Cyno Normal Attack hits — Electro DMG Bonus per stack (maximum 5)
Together We Rise recipient Normal/Charged hits — Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus per stack (maximum 5); not raw attached EM damage

constellations.name: Precept: Lawful Enforcer
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Austerity: Forbidding Guard
constellations.description:
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, after he triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reaction, he will restore 3 Elemental Energy for all nearby party members (except himself.)
This effect can occur 5 times within one use of Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness.

Enhanced kit — conditional Radiance state
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, after he triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reaction, he will restore 3 Elemental Energy to all nearby party members (except himself). This effect can occur 5 times within one use of Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness.

When other characters affected by Together We Rise trigger the aforementioned reaction, they will also regenerate 20 Elemental Energy for Cyno. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

constellations.name: Funerary Rite: The Passing of Starlight
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Raiment: Just Scales
constellations.description:
After using Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness or triggering the Judication effect of the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment," Cyno will gain 4 stacks of the "Day of the Jackal" effect. When he hits opponents with Normal Attacks, he will consume 1 stack of "Day of the Jackal" to fire off one Duststalker Bolt.
"Day of the Jackal" lasts for 8s. Max 8 stacks. It will be canceled once Pactsworn Pathclearer ends.
A maximum of 1 Duststalker Bolt can be unleashed this way every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

Enhanced kit — conditional Radiance state
After using Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness or triggering the Judication effect of the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment," Cyno will gain 4 stacks of the "Day of the Jackal" effect. When he hits opponents with Normal Attacks, he will consume 1 stack of "Day of the Jackal" to fire off one Duststalker Bolt. If Cyno is affected by Together We Rise, he will fire one Duststalker Bolt - Starsame instead.
Day of the Jackal" lasts for 8s. Max 8 stacks for each instance of Pactsworn Pathclearer. It will be canceled once Pactsworn Pathclearer from Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness ends.
A maximum of 1 Duststalker Bolt or 1 Duststalker Bolt - Starsame can be unleashed this way every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."

skills.label: Day of the Jackal — one ordinary Duststalker Bolt, without Together We Rise; select only this variant for the trigger
Day of the Jackal with Together We Rise — one Starsame Bolt replacing the ordinary Bolt; select only this variant for the trigger
